text:
lina: Heads up — shadow cohort (cohort=shadow-12) shows p99 jump ~3x after runtime v2.3.4 canary swap. Customer-reported latency from Support.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: runtime v2.3.4 -> canary cohorts @ 1746799900 :rocket:
lina: rolling back not yet. want to triage first, might be scheduler change + kernel selector tweak.
raj: ack, grabbing traces and flamegraphs. can someone post the sample request ids?
susan: @lina any config changes to batching or kv-cache defaults with this build?
lina: only scheduler: default_max_inflight lowered, and a small change in late-binding kernel heuristics. no kv or auth changes.
carmen-support: customer says median OK but p95/p99 for long sequences (~1500 tokens) spikes a lot; they provided request_id 0x9b7f2a and 0x9b7f2b.
mike-telemetry: pulling traces for those ids now. quick look: tail shows big GC-like pauses and a few requests hitting different kernel path.
raj: here's a quick query I ran:
```
curl -s "https://telemetry/api/v1/traces?service=runtime&request_id=0x9b7f2a" | jq '.spans[] | {name, duration_ms, tags: .tags}' 
```
mike-telemetry: sample output (truncated):
```
{"name":"kv-cache.lookup","duration_ms":12}
{"name":"kernel.select","duration_ms":320}
{"name":"token-gen","duration_ms":1450}
```
raj: kernel.select 320ms is suspicious; older builds usually 20-30ms there for same path.
susan: could be the new late-binding heuristics routing to the slow sparse kernel for long sequences.
lina: hypothesis: for long sequences our selector chooses a sparse kernel that is worse for this model/seq length combo. can we reproduce with the canary binary locally?
raj: repro steps I ran:
1) checkout release/v2.3.4
2) run local harness with sample workload (seq=1500, batch=1)
3) curl to /generate with same model variant
I see kernel.select durations consistent with telemetry.
raj: gist of command:
```
./run_harness --model redwood-open-15b --seq 1500 --batch 1 --profile kernel
```
mike-telemetry: also noticed increased CPU sys % during those runs; stack traces point at the selector code path.
susan: short-term mitigation options:
- force selector to previous heuristic via env var: RUNTIME_KERNEL_SELECTOR=legacy
- increase small-batch fallback: RUNTIME_SMALL_BATCH_THRESHOLD=8
- traffic-split rollback for shadow cohort to previous runtime
lina: agree. priority: minimize customer impact while we root cause. propose traffic-split rollback for shadow-12 -> v2.3.2 then debug offline.
carmen-support: customer is ok with immediate rollback if it reduces tail — they asked for ETA.
raj: I can flip the traffic-split. plan:
- step 1: change cohort assignment -> v2.3.2 (gradual 50% -> 100%)
- step 2: monitor p95/p99 for 20m
- step 3: if stable, promote rollback fully and create a hotpatch branch
ops-bot: runbook | traffic-split command:
```
redwoodctl cohort update shadow-12 --runtime-version v2.3.2 --ramp 50
```
lina: after ramping to 50% we saw p99 drop from ~950ms -> ~180ms in the sample traces.
mike-telemetry: confirming metrics dashboard shows cohort p99 falling quickly. still watching for regressions.
raj: follow-up investigation notes: add unit test harness that exercises kernel selector on seq lengths (512, 1024, 1500, 2048) and assert expected kernel path. filing PR to add a regression test.
susan: long-term: add telemetry alert that kernel.select duration > 100ms for cohorted traffic and auto-route to fallback.
lina: thanks everyone. Carmen, update customer: rolled shadow cohort back to v2.3.2, p99 reduced, root cause suspected kernel-selector heuristic. we'll follow up with timeline for fix and hotpatch.
carmen-support: will notify customer and mark as prioritized. :white_check_mark:
mike-telemetry: created dashboard panel and alert ticket (TKT-4219) and shared link.
raj: I'll open a bisect branch to pinpoint commit in selector. assigning to @susan for kernel selector review.
susan: on it, starting bisect now.
lina: leaving this thread open until we have a fix/hotpatch confirmation. thanks for the quick turnaround :heart:
ops-bot: note: rollback completed at 1746802400. monitoring window ends at 1746803200.
mike-telemetry: last check-in — p99 for shadow-12 stable at baseline for 30m. closing initial escalation.
